about: Every host the Leaguewise extension contacts, and every page it runs on. NETWORK.md is this list in words. It is checked against the code before each release.

sent: the league id and season in the path
an X-Fantasy-Filter header on pool and weekly requests

hosts.optIn: only while the betting lines option is on; it is off by default

sent: a player id or a club abbreviation in the path
the logo's own address, as the league payload gives it

hosts.cookies: an image load, under the browser's own rules for one
sent: the logo's own address, as the league payload gives it

cookieRead.note: read through the browser's cookies API to know whether the reader is signed in to ESPN, and to tell which team is theirs. Not a request.

notRequests.why: the SVG namespace name in generated markup. A browser never contacts it.

contentScripts.what: ESPN's draft room. Reads the draft's own messages in the reader's tab while a draft is on. Opens no connection of its own.
